decision_rules.PASS: All mandatory gates pass, improvement >= 5% in primary scenario, P95 guardrail passes, and frozen protocol/reproducibility requirements pass.
decision_rules.FAIL: Any mandatory gate fails, or the frozen performance rule is not met under the predeclared evaluation method.
decision_rules.INCONCLUSIVE: Invalid run, missing required outputs, unresolved reproducibility issue, or predeclared uncertainty criterion is not met.

caveats: Existing results are deterministic synthetic-model outputs, not field measurements.
5% is a candidate target, not an empirically established industry standard.
No team or RTA approval is claimed.
Independent reproduction and microscopic-simulator cross-check remain outstanding.
Passing model invariants does not establish real-world safety.
freeze_prerequisites: Complete SUMO or comparable microscopic cross-check
Freeze scenario matrix, source/configuration versions, metrics, horizon, and decision rules
Predeclare stochastic run plan and uncertainty method if applicable
Archive protocol before confirmatory results are generated
